title: Fix for-loop variable modifications and unread private fields
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
1. **Loop stop condition variable modifications (3 instances):** Modifying the loop index inside the body — `MemorySmithContentEndpoints.cs` (L151), `CodeSearchService.cs` (L3079, L3101)
2. **Loop incrementer not tied to stop condition (1 instance):** `MemoryChatAgent.ToolLoop.cs` (L94)
3. **Unread private fields (5 instances):** `MemoryViewer.razor` (L422), `TagManager.razor.cs` (L18, L19, L22, L28)

## Impact
Modifying loop variables inside the body can cause infinite loops or unexpected termination. Unread fields indicate dead code or incomplete implementation.

## Action Required
1. Refactor loop variable modifications to `while` loops with explicit control or separate tracking variables
2. Ensure loop condition tests the incremented variable
3. Remove unread fields, or implement the code that uses them

## Effort
~1h15min

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
